digest.component_or_area: Architecture Decision Record (ADR) — operation-scoped config and provider-auth composition
propositions: Rebar must compose immutable non-secret operation configuration separately from provider-auth and runtime bindings at application boundaries.

Operation snapshots are immutable, non-secret, and take precedence via root rules with defined lifecycle; provider-native auth/session injection occurs at Rebar-owned composition seams, not throughout the application.

Provider-specific static carriers (SecretStr/SecretBytes) and subprocess environment rules must not mutate global os.environ; restart/redeploy enables static rotation while SDK-owned refresh remains distinct.

Op-cert startup composition requires exactly one path or multiline value source, single validation before service work, process-owned file permissions (0700/0600), and context-local signer/principal/push policy without application runtime SSM/boto3 coupling.
ADR 0049's Ed25519/DSSE protocol, trust roots, producer, and SSM-at-rest storage decisions remain authoritative; ADR 0098 amends only per-job retrieval and global composition seams.
No universal secret broker, keyring, cloud-secret retrieval, or hot-rotation ownership by Rebar; fail-closed decision-bearing auth and optional observability capture are explicit design choices.
